dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the mid-lateral body. These features possess irregular, jagged light-grey outer perimeters with a sharp transition into darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters located primarily along the dorsal ridge and posterior flank, lacking internal contrast gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central lateral region form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, thin 'S' shaped light-colored mark is located on the anterior lateral portion of the neck area.
